name: MonarchAppAccessPicker
title: AppAccessPicker
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of rows with androidx.compose.foundation.selection.toggleable(role = Role.Checkbox) around androidx.compose.material3.Checkbox, MonarchAvatar, MonarchBadge, a ghost MonarchButton and MonarchSkeleton; MonarchAppAccessSummary is MonarchTag in androidx.compose.foundation.layout.FlowRow
summary: A checklist of apps to grant a member, with each app's logo, name, tag and description, Select all or Clear all with a count, and MonarchAppAccessSummary, the compact read-only line of granted apps for a member row.
whenToUse: When inviting someone to a workspace or editing a member's access, to choose which apps they can open; use MonarchAppAccessSummary in the member list to show what they have.
whenNotToUse: For roles with permissions, use MonarchRolePicker or MonarchPermissionMatrix. For a generic list of options, use MonarchCheckboxGroup.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAppAccessPicker(apps: List<MonarchAppAccessOption>, value: List<String>, onValueChange: (List<String>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, loading: Boolean = false, hideLabel: Boolean = false, showBulkActions: Boolean = true, description: String? = null, labels: MonarchAppAccessPickerLabels = MonarchAppAccessPickerLabels())

@ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchAppAccessSummary(apps: List<MonarchAppAccessOption>, value: List<String>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, max: Int = 2, noneLabel: String? = null, moreLabel: ((count: Int, names: String) -> String)? = null)
class MonarchAppAccessOption(id: String, name: String, description: String? = null, logo: Painter? = null, badge: String? = null, enabled: Boolean = true)

class MonarchAppAccessPickerLabels(label: String? = null, selectAll: String? = null, clearAll: String? = null, count: ((selected: Int, total: Int) -> String)? = null, loading: String? = null, empty: String? = null)

options.name: apps
options.description: The apps that can be granted, in display order.

options.name: value
options.description: The ids of the selected apps.

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the new list of selected ids; a newly selected id is added at the end.

options.name: enabled
options.description: false disables every row and the bulk action, for example while saving.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows three placeholder rows instead of the apps.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Hides the visible heading; TalkBack still reads the label as the name of the group.

options.name: showBulkActions
options.description: Shows the count and Select all or Clear all above the list.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text under the list, such as when the grants take effect.

options.name: max (MonarchAppAccessSummary)
options.description: How many names the summary shows before +N, at least one.

options.name: noneLabel, moreLabel (MonarchAppAccessSummary)
options.description: Replace "No app access" and the spoken ", and 2 more: …".

states.name: unselected
states.description: An empty checkbox; the row reads as an unchecked checkbox.

states.name: selected
states.description: A ticked checkbox; the count goes up and the bulk button reads Clear all once every changeable app is selected.

states.name: fixed app
states.description: An app with enabled false is shown in the disabled text color with its checkbox disabled, ticked or not; Select all and Clear all leave it as it is.

states.name: disabled
states.description: enabled false disables every row and the bulk button.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three skeleton rows, read once as Loading apps; the count and bulk button are hidden.

states.name: empty
states.description: "No apps are available yet." in muted text.

states.name: summary
states.description: MonarchAppAccessSummary shows the first names as tags and +N, or "No app access".

appearance: Rows of a Material 3 checkbox, a square MonarchAvatar logo (the initial on a tinted tile without a logo), the name in default body text with an optional neutral MonarchBadge and the description in muted caption text; disabled rows use the disabled text color. The count is muted caption text and the bulk action a small ghost button. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web's fieldset with a legend becomes a heading and a traversal group; with hideLabel the group carries the label as its content description. The web takes a logo URL; Android takes a Painter loaded by the app, as every Monarch picture does. The web's badge and description are React nodes; here they are strings. The web's small xs button is the Sm ghost MonarchButton, which keeps a 48dp touch target. The rows are a plain Column, not a LazyColumn, because the picker sits in the app's scrolling invite or member form. The summary sorts the names with java.text.Collator for the device locale where the web uses localeCompare. There is no iOS AppAccessPicker yet. Experimental: a product composite that waits for a Rook app to adopt it.
accessibility: Each row is one TalkBack element with the checkbox role and its on or off state, read as the name, the tag and the description, and is at least 48dp high.
Apps that cannot be changed and a disabled picker are reported as disabled and ignore taps.
The selection count is a polite live region, so a change is announced.
The label is a heading; with hideLabel it names the group instead.
Placeholder rows are hidden and read once as "Loading apps".
Logos are decorative; the summary is read as one element that includes the names behind +N.
Selection is shown by the checkbox mark, not by color alone.
edgeCases: Ids in value that are not in apps are kept by Select all and Clear all, and the summary shows them as the id.
A duplicate id in value is counted once in the summary.
Long names and descriptions wrap; the tag moves to the next line.
max below one still shows one name.
With no changeable apps the bulk button is disabled.

examples.title: Invite with app access
examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAppAccessPicker(
    apps = listOf(
        MonarchAppAccessOption({{apps.0.id}}, {{apps.0.name}}, description = {{apps.0.description}}),
        MonarchAppAccessOption({{apps.1.id}}, {{apps.1.name}}, description = {{apps.1.description}}),
        MonarchAppAccessOption({{apps.2.id}}, {{apps.2.name}}, description = {{apps.2.description}}),
        MonarchAppAccessOption({{apps.3.id}}, {{apps.3.name}}, description = {{apps.3.description}}, badge = {{apps.3.badge}}),
    ),
    value = granted,
    onValueChange = { granted = it },
    description = {{description}},
)
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchAppAccessPicker(
    apps = listOf(
        MonarchAppAccessOption("notes", "Notes", description = "Shared notes and documents"),
        MonarchAppAccessOption("planner", "Planner", description = "Projects, tasks and timelines"),
        MonarchAppAccessOption("calendar", "Calendar", description = "Team calendars and booking pages"),
        MonarchAppAccessOption("helpdesk", "Helpdesk", description = "Customer tickets", badge = "Beta"),
    ),
    value = granted,
    onValueChange = { granted = it },
    description = "Joining a workspace grants no app access on its own. These apps are applied when the invitation is accepted.",
)
